description.value: Pizzeria Prima Strada is a neighbourhood wood-fired Neapolitan pizza restaurant in Cook Street Village that has been serving Victoria for over 15 years. The menu centres on thin-crust pizzas baked in a wood-fired oven, housemade gelato, antipasti, pasta, and a curated selection of Italian wines and craft beer. The relaxed, community-focused atmosphere makes it a natural rest stop for touring cyclists exploring Victoria's south end.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: staple (4 spaces) at 33m; staple (4 spaces) at 33m; rack (6 spaces) at 35m; rack at 45m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active wood-fired pizza restaurant at 230 Cook St, Victoria. Takeout and delivery are explicitly offered via an online ordering system. A December 2025 blog post confirms the Fort Street location closed; OSM coordinates (48.4141, -123.3569) align with the Cook Street Village area, which the website shows as the single remaining open location with blog activity as recently as May 22, 2026. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi confirmation appears in the website content, though the OSM tag internet_access=wlan suggests Wi-Fi exists but cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation.
